definitions.entryPoints: An array of objects, each with type UI|MCP|API|CLI|EXTERNAL and exact path/tool name and availability
definitions.personaAccess: Actual roles and action scopes; distinguish view permission from mutate capability
definitions.organizationEntitlement: Per-org and per-system feature access; pricing tier not an assurance verdict
definitions.localPrerequisites: Only those needed for this user's goal (not global stage gating)
definitions.sourceAndEvidenceRequirements: Accepted evidence types, connection and qualification gates, fallback manual input and freshness
definitions.evidencePlaneCoverage: Requested, Policy Authorized, Effectively Granted, Code Capable, Observed may be independently unsupported/not-assessed
definitions.humanDecisionRequirements: Approver identity, scopes, expiry, revocation, SoD as applicable
definitions.evaluationAndOutputs: Canonical persisted status, reports/passports/receipts/reconstruction output and exact source basis
definitions.limitations: Evidence/feature unavailable reasons and user-visible next step
definitions.testsOrValidation: Bounded tests, security/privacy checks, runtime evidence and deployed release identity

entryPoints.name: existing haiec_preflight + haiec_run_assurance; check canonical registry
